entities.summary: Marcos Henrique "Didi" Louzada Silva is a Brazilian professional basketball player for Sesi Franca of the Novo Basquete Brasil (NBB). At the 2019 NBA draft, he was drafted by the Atlanta Hawks, before being traded to the New Orleans Pelicans.
